summary: Phase 5 (Module 4.6 Executive Analytics + NL Analytics Console + AI Examiner co-pilot) — full backend + frontend testing. 14/14 Phase 5 backend tests pass. Phase 1+2 regression: 18/18 pass. All 5 Analytics tabs + NL Console + AI Examiner dialog + institution switch all verified end-to-end against real LLM calls (Claude / OpenAI gpt-4o).

issues: Recharts logs width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on first paint before container measures. Cosmetic console warning only — charts render correctly after layout. Optionally wrap ResponsiveContainer with explicit minHeight to silence.

action_items: Pre-existing Phase 4 test brittleness (NOT a Phase 5 regression): /app/backend/tests/test_phase4.py::TestPsychometrics::test_summary, test_rules_list_4, test_patch_rule_disable_and_persist fail because previous Phase 4 testing run created TEST_new_rule, so EAIC rules count is now 5 (test asserts ==4). Tests should be updated to assert >=4 and filter by id, or seed cleanup needs to run. Phase 1+2 + Phase 5 are 100% green.
critical_code_review_comments: INTENT_CATALOG dispatcher in routes_analytics.py is clean and well-bounded. The 'unsupported' branch with available_intents list is a great UX touch.
AI Examiner endpoint correctly enforces tenant scope BEFORE invoking the LLM (line 494 _scope check on item.institution_id) — cross-tenant test confirms 403 without burning an LLM call.
Audit logging is consistent: both analytics.nl_query and ai.examiner.run write to audit_logs with model + actor + ts. Verified via /compliance recent[].
Workforce heatmap correctly falls back to (target-2) when no learner profiles exist for a role — sensible default that keeps the UI populated.
Minor: Recharts ResponsiveContainer prints width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on initial mount in Analytics.jsx. Cosmetic only; charts render correctly after layout settles.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5 tabs + NL Console + Examiner dialog + institution switch all verified)
